<python>
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

# Load the image
image_path = '/data1/yuhongjie2/OpenEarthAgent/data/train_images/dior_09572.jpg'
img = plt.imread(image_path)

# Bounding box coordinates (smallest overpass)
x, y, width, height = 769.5172729492188, 136.59519958496094, 16.122581481933594, 3.332287549972534

# Plot the image
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.imshow(img)

# Draw the bounding box
rect = Rectangle((x, y), width, height, linewidth=2, edgecolor='red', facecolor='none')
ax.add_patch(rect)

# Save the output
output_path = '/data1/yuhongjie2/OpenEarthAgent/data/train_images/dior_09572_bbox.jpg'
plt.imsave(output_path, img)
plt.close()
</python>
